identity_privacy.title: Your identity stays private
identity_privacy.signup_freelancer_body: Your name, email address and phone number are hidden from Teams while browsing and matching. Your contact details are revealed only after an explicit match confirmation.
identity_privacy.signup_team_body: Your identifying and contact details are hidden from Professionals while browsing and matching. Your contact details are revealed only after an explicit match confirmation.
identity_privacy.profile_freelancer_body: PITCALL needs these details, but your name, email address and phone number are not shown to Teams before an explicit match confirmation.
identity_privacy.profile_team_body: PITCALL needs these details, but your identifying and contact details are not shown to Professionals before an explicit match confirmation.
